full_judgment: 10. It appears from the case records that the disputed property comprising an area of 10.67 acres appertaining to Mouza Madhurai under Upazila Balaganj of District Sylhet stands in JL No. 232 and Khatian No. 1. The portion of suit land measuring an area of 5.68 acres lies in plot No. 14/135 and in plot No. 21 the area of suit land is 4.99 acres. It is the case of the plaintiffs that they acquired the land by two registered deeds dated 04-11-1932 and 14-6-1956. Admittedly during S.A. Record the land has been recorded as 'jalmahal' under the government in its khash Khatian No. 1 and it is the contention of the plaintiffs that the property is not a 'jalmahal' rather cultivable land and 'boro' corps are being produced therein.
